calculation.description: Contrarian range-location score across the 15 tradable benchmark assets. Assets near the bottom of their own completed 60-session high-low range receive larger positive values, while assets near the top receive negative values. The signal uses only the latest completed OHLC bar available at each decision and is evaluated against subsequent returns.
calculation.direction: positive factor values predict higher forward returns

metrics.average_instruments_per_date: computed with minimum 8 valid instruments; see signal artifact

validation.regime_notes: Positive across the full 2020-2032 synthetic history; H10 IC is strongest in 2028-2032 in supplementary inspection. Small cross-asset cross-sections imply conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC using all available tradable instruments and requiring at least 8 valid instruments per date. Forward return is close[t+10]/close[t]-1.
